note: Claude's next upgrade ideas, shown in the app (🤖 Claude > 💡 Ideas, or ask the chat "give me ideas"). 👍 Do it turns one into a request. Claude keeps this list fresh: take out what was built, add new ones. Plain words, no tenant data. "plan" = the next items of docs/MASTER_PLAN.md: the app asks the owner "✅ Do all" and sends them as one request ("(plan) Do all, in order ..."); when they are live, put the next plan items here with a new id.

ideas.title: The helper calls the tenant for you
ideas.why: It dials, says who you are and asks for a time; you hear it and take over any time (needs the phone service).

ideas.title: The robot says what it sees
ideas.why: Take a before photo and the robot names the problem (leak stain, mold, broken plaster) and adds it to the job notes.

ideas.title: HPD emails in 20 seconds
ideas.why: When you open the app, the robot sums up new HPD emails out loud: who wrote, which job, what they want.

ideas.title: Say the price, the bid fills itself
ideas.why: On a bid say "2,400" and the price goes on page 1, page 2 and the work form at once.

ideas.title: Tenants confirm with one tap
ideas.why: The tenant gets a link: tap Yes / Change time. The map shows confirmed in green by itself.

ideas.title: Open in one second
ideas.why: The app shows the last screen right away and fills in new numbers after, instead of "Loading jobs".

ideas.title: A cleaner screen
ideas.why: Hide the buttons you never use; the map gets more room and the robot stands out.

ideas.title: Notice answers written for you
ideas.why: When a 24/72-hour notice comes in, the answer is already written with the dates; you check it and tap twice to send.

ideas.title: Send a job to your worker
ideas.why: One tap texts a worker the address, the work and the photos needed.

ideas.title: Tenant texts in Spanish
ideas.why: When the tenant writes in Spanish, the app shows it in English and writes your answer in Spanish.

ideas.title: Morning plan in 20 seconds
ideas.why: At 7 AM the chat says today's jobs in the best order, bids due, notices and the weather, out loud, with one tap to start the route.

ideas.title: The chat asks the next step
ideas.why: After every answer it offers the next useful thing, like "Text the tenant?" or "Open the affidavit?", so you finish each job in a few taps.

ideas.title: See Claude's change before you try it
ideas.why: When Claude finishes a request it puts a picture of the new screen in Your requests, so you see what changed at a glance.

ideas.title: Price coach on every bid
ideas.why: Next to the price box: the prices that won this kind of job in the last 6 months, and how likely your price is to win.

ideas.title: Which bids you win
ideas.why: Your win rate by borough and type of work, and the prices that won, so you know where to bid lower or higher.

ideas.title: One-hand mode
ideas.why: A switch that moves the main buttons to the bottom corner so you can reach everything with your thumb while holding tools.

ideas.title: Notes on every job
ideas.why: Type or say a note on a job card (like gate code or who to ask for). It shows up next time you open that job.

ideas.title: Money coming in
ideas.why: One screen with invoices sent, paid and still waiting, with the oldest unpaid first.

ideas.title: Photos work with no signal
ideas.why: Take before and after photos in a basement with no signal; they send by themselves when you are back online.

ideas.title: Chat notes show on the job card
ideas.why: What you told the chat to remember about an address also shows on that job's card, so you see it before you knock.

ideas.title: Tap to call the super
ideas.why: On a job card, one tap calls or texts the contact you saved for that address.

ideas.title: Send tomorrow's route
ideas.why: One tap sends tomorrow's route (addresses only) to your own phone or a helper's.

ideas.title: Photo checklist per job
ideas.why: Each job shows the photos HPD needs (before, after, close-up) with ticks as you take them.

ideas.title: Insurance and license dates
ideas.why: The app warns you 30 days before an insurance or license paper runs out.

ideas.title: Bids with no price yet
ideas.why: A small count on the Bids button of invitations still waiting for your price.

ideas.title: Rain check on the route
ideas.why: If rain or snow is coming, the route plan puts indoor jobs first and warns you about outdoor ones.

ideas.title: Rejected job fixer
ideas.why: When HPD rejects a job, the app lists exactly what to redo and puts it first on tomorrow's route.

ideas.title: Month at a glance
ideas.why: One card with jobs done, invoices paid and money still waiting this month.

ideas.title: Dark screen at night
ideas.why: A switch for a dark screen that is easier on the eyes in a dark truck.

ideas.title: Bigger buttons with gloves on
ideas.why: A switch that makes every button bigger so you can tap it with work gloves.

ideas.title: Invoice already filled in
ideas.why: When the affidavit is approved, the invoice opens with the job, the amount and the OMO already filled, so you only check it and send.

ideas.title: All jobs with paperwork left
ideas.why: One list on the home screen of every finished job that still has photos, an affidavit or an invoice missing, oldest first.

ideas.title: Building history
ideas.why: Every past job at this address with its photos and notes, one tap from the job card.

ideas.title: Invoice check before sending
ideas.why: Before the invoice goes out, the app checks the amount matches the award and the COA, and says what doesn't.

ideas.title: How long each kind of work takes
ideas.why: The robot tells you, from your timed jobs, how long doors, plaster or locks usually take, so you can plan the day and price bids.

ideas.title: Job is taking long
ideas.why: If you are on a job much longer than your usual time, the robot asks if you want to text the next tenant that you are running late.

ideas.title: Did you bring everything?
ideas.why: Before you leave the office, the robot reads the shopping list for today's jobs and asks if the truck has it all.

ideas.title: Photos named by themselves
ideas.why: Each photo is saved with the job number and before/after in its name, so nothing gets mixed up.

ideas.title: Works better with weak signal
ideas.why: The map and job list stay usable with weak signal and say "waiting for signal" instead of freezing.

ideas.title: Photos in the order HPD likes
ideas.why: Before / after photos are lined up in pairs on the paperwork, so HPD reads them at a glance and rejects fewer packages.

ideas.title: Who pays slowly
ideas.why: A short list of the jobs HPD has not paid yet, oldest first, with one tap to write the follow-up for you to check.

ideas.title: Alert when HPD pays
ideas.why: The robot rings when a payment you were waiting on shows as paid, with the job number and amount.

ideas.title: Stop double sends
ideas.why: Before anything goes to HPD the app checks if that job number was already sent and says so in plain words.

ideas.title: Best time to text
ideas.why: The robot picks the hour tenants answer most and holds the first text until then.

ideas.title: End of day recap
ideas.why: At 6 PM one short note: what got done, what is left for tomorrow, and which notice is due first.

ideas.title: Missing photo warning
ideas.why: Before you finish a job the app says which required photo (before, after, close-up) is still missing.

ideas.title: No-access proof in one tap
ideas.why: When a tenant is not home, one tap saves the time, the door photo and the call tries for the no-access paperwork.

ideas.title: Price hint from your past wins
ideas.why: On a bid, the app shows the prices you won at for the same kind of work, so you can choose faster.

ideas.title: Overdue notices on top, always
ideas.why: Anything overdue from HPD sits at the very top of the home screen in red, before the map and everything else.

ideas.title: Works in a basement with no signal
ideas.why: Jobs, photos and forms save on the phone and send themselves when the signal comes back.

ideas.title: Bid price that wins
ideas.why: Shows what prices won on similar jobs before and suggests a price in the winning range.

ideas.title: One Notes box per HPD email
ideas.why: Every HPD email shows as three lines on the job card: what they want, what you already sent, what is missing.

ideas.title: Try it from the update popup
ideas.why: Each line in the ✨ new upgrade popup gets a ▶ Try it that opens the screen that changed, so you see it in one tap.

ideas.title: All proofs for the month
ideas.why: One list of every job you sent to HPD this month with its date and PDF, so you answer vendor tracking for many jobs at once.

ideas.title: HPD asked twice
ideas.why: The app flags when HPD asks for something you already sent, with the date and file name to reply with.

ideas.title: Edit any idea before you build it
ideas.why: Open an idea, change its words or drop it, then say Build. Nothing is built until you approve.

ideas.title: One list of everything the app does
ideas.why: A plain list of every feature in the app, so you can see what it already has and pick what to change.

ideas.title: Zoom and scroll on the map
ideas.why: Pinch to zoom the map in and out, and it scrolls to the job you tap, like the bids screen does.

ideas.title: Helper stays quiet until you ask
ideas.why: The helper never talks by itself; it speaks only after you tap it, in a clear voice you can pick.

ideas.title: Answer for HPD, ready to read
ideas.why: When HPD writes, the app drafts a short plain answer from the job's facts; you read it and tap send.

ideas.title: Job stopwatch
ideas.why: Tap Start when you arrive and Done when you leave; the time is kept on the job for your pay and for HPD questions.

ideas.title: Red badge on bids due soon
ideas.why: Bids due in under 24 hours get a red badge on the list, so none is missed.

ideas.title: Snap the receipt, cost goes on the job
ideas.why: Photo of a store receipt adds the amount to that job's cost.

ideas.title: Next job in one tap
ideas.why: When you finish a job, one button opens directions to the next one.

ideas.title: Notice countdown on the home screen
ideas.why: The most urgent notice and its hours left sit at the top of the app.

ideas.title: What HPD changed since yesterday
ideas.why: One line per job: new notice, new rejection, new payment since you last looked.

ideas.title: Text size button
ideas.why: A button to make all text bigger or smaller, remembered next time.

ideas.title: This week vs last week
ideas.why: The week card shows an arrow next to each number: up or down compared with last week.

ideas.title: Friday 4 PM week alert
ideas.why: A phone alert on Friday afternoon with the week's numbers, so you do not have to open the app.

ideas.title: Second no-access try reminder
ideas.why: After a no-show, the app reminds you of the second try 72 hours later with the tenant text already written.

ideas.title: Alert when the wait is over
ideas.why: At the end of the no-show wait, your phone rings so you know it is time to take the door photos and leave.

ideas.title: Try it on a test job
ideas.why: Try it makes a pretend job for you, so you can tap through the new screen without touching a real job.

ideas.title: Check off each Try it step
ideas.why: Each Try it step gets a tick when you finish it, and Works only turns on after all steps are ticked.

ideas.title: Second try on the calendar
ideas.why: The planned second try after no access shows on the day in your week view, so the 72-hour wait is never missed.

ideas.title: Price hint by kind of work
ideas.why: When you price an invitation to bid, the app shows what that kind of work (doors, plumbing, plaster) has paid you per day before.

ideas.title: HPD's pages with the job message
ideas.why: Send to a worker sends the text and HPD's description pages together in one share, so it's one tap instead of two.

ideas.title: The AI remembers how you work
ideas.why: It learns your usual prices, workers and the order you like jobs in, so its answers fit you without you explaining again.

ideas.title: AI tells you the day out loud
ideas.why: At 7 AM tap once: it reads what is due today, the first job, the notices and the bids closing, in under a minute.

ideas.title: AI checks photos before you leave
ideas.why: It looks at the before / after photos on site and says if one is blurry, dark or missing, so HPD does not reject the package.

ideas.title: HPD email becomes a to-do
ideas.why: When HPD writes, the AI puts what they want on that job card as a task with the due date, and reminds you.

ideas.title: Ask the AI anything about a job
ideas.why: "When did I send ER03395?" or "Is 73 Eastern Pkwy paid?" gets one clear answer from your own records.

ideas.title: Answer a tenant from the replies list
ideas.why: In Tenant replies, a ready answer under each text: one tap to send it, without opening the job first.

ideas.title: Miles driven, for taxes
ideas.why: The app adds up the miles of each day's route and keeps a monthly total you can give your accountant.

ideas.title: Why HPD rejects you
ideas.why: A short count of the reasons HPD sent jobs back in the last 3 months, so you fix the one that happens most.

ideas.title: Tenant reminder the morning of the visit
ideas.why: At 8 AM the tenant gets a short text: "We come today between ... and ...", so fewer no-access trips.

ideas.title: After photo from the same spot
ideas.why: When you take the after photo, the before photo shows faded on the camera so both are taken from the same angle.

ideas.title: Money coming next month
ideas.why: From the invoices you sent and how long HPD usually takes to pay, one number: what should come in next month.

plan.title: Next on the plan: finish every job on time

items.title: Money in this week's maturity
items.why: The Maturity this week card shows each job's award amount and the total, so you see how much money is riding on this week.

items.title: Route for this week's maturity
items.why: A button on the Maturity this week card opens Plan my day with just those jobs, closest date first.
